collection.title: Ford Focus Hatchback 2011 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Focus Hatchback 2011 - 2015 version requires a 29" wiper blade for both drivers and passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Focus which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below. Please Note - Some brands recommend 2 x 28" front blades which are slightly shorter than the originals.
